account-manager v1.0.0

- Initial release with core account switching workflow for banned accounts (WeChat/Douyin).
- Supports device scheduling, friend migration, account state management, and pre-switch friend filtering/notification.
- Integrates with device-operations-mcp and provides risk alerting for high-value contacts.
- Includes full input/output JSON formats, workflow description, error codes, and usage scenarios.
